title: Review and Approve

body.text: When a task finishes, Codex shows a
diff — a summary of which files changed and what lines were added/removed
. Your job is to read the diff like reviewing a teammate's PR, then approve.

example: "The diff shows: 3 files changed, added a spinner component, edited checkout.tsx, added 2 test cases — read it, then click approve"

title: Review like a professional

body.text: does it match the task · does it touch files beyond the scope · do the tests pass · are there hidden side effects
— if it's not right, ask for fixes within the same task; no need to start over.

example: "Almost there, but the spinner should use the theme color, not a hardcoded #3b82f6 — fix this and resend"

options.text: A summary of code changes: which files, what was added/removed

question: What should you check before approving?

options.text: Matches the task, within scope, tests pass
Number of lines added — the more the better
No need to check, the AI is always right

question: If the work is almost good but needs fixes, what should you do?

options.text: Approve it and fix it yourself later
Ask for the specific fixes within the same task
Delete the task and write all the code yourself

question: How should you review Codex's work professionally?

options.text: Read, understand, and test before approving
To prevent bugs or code that doesn't match the intent
